goal: Prevent transaction origin deanonymization for users running with -privatebroadcast
Stop the wallet from re-adding dropped unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool
agreement: Strong support because it stops unintended rebroadcasts of dust or external transactions (andrewtoth)
Objection that re-adding to mempool leaks origin was resolved by disabling resubmit (davidgumberg)
Open suggestion to simplify the functional test (andrewtoth)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because re-adding dropped transactions under -privatebroadcast exposes origin privacy to peers
Relay peers fetching an evicted transaction held only locally can trivially deanonymize the node

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because wallet resubmissions on startup or intervals undermine private broadcast protections
Protects against inadvertent rebroadcast of external or dust transactions linked to the wallet
